findings.summary: egress/stream.py and runtime/resources.py are exactly 800 lines (check_sizes max 800) and the design edits both (_terminate classification, unauth_audit_rate + multiplier) with no size budget; commits 2 and 5 would fail the gate. Fix: put unauth_audit_rate in runtime/resources_audit.py with a one-line delegate, move the _terminate action choice into a domain helper, state net line counts, run check_sizes in commits 2 and 5.

merge_row rebuilds stored metadata from a fixed key list (source, request_id, phases, pipeline_trace, zeroshield, module_id), so refused_at and key_fingerprint added in translate are dropped and D-21 totals cannot work; blocked/redacted counts and the ORM filter for refused_at are unspecified. Fix: carry both keys through merge_row (recompute refused_at from the winning trace), add merge tests, specify the exclude expression and treat legacy rows as today.
credential_unavailable, provider_unreachable, store_not_configured in PREDISPATCH_OPERATIONAL are vector-path codes, not reachable on chat; say tests drive them via build_stages directly.
Input redact followed by upstream error becomes final error and drops out of redacted/total_threats; record as a known gap or count any redact/flag/block stage.
